'''Justin Branch''' (GEMP handle '''Silverglen''') is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref>. He was runner-up at the [[2021 Online Championship Series]] to [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]. He played the [[2026 Jawa Cup]].<ref name="ocs2021">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-online-championship-series-wrap-mht-victorious/ 2021 Online Championship Series Wrap – MHT victorious], Players Committee (29 November 2021)</ref><ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-03-jawa-cup-dec-2025-to-mar-2026/ 2026 Jawa Cup], starwarsccg.org</ref>
